args.title: Sphere 2027 Individual Medical Plans — Archive Comparison
args.body:
# Sphere 2027 Individual Medical Plans — Archive Comparison

**Archive date:** January 1, 2028  
**Plan year:** January 1–December 31, 2027  
**Enrollment deadline:** October 23, 2026 at 5:00 PM Eastern

| Term | Individual HDHP | Individual PPO |
|---|---:|---:|
| Employee premium per biweekly paycheck | $98 | $164 |
| Annual payroll premium (26 paychecks) | $2,548 | $4,264 |
| Deductible | $2,300 | $750 |
| Coinsurance after deductible | 10% | 20% |
| Preventive care | Fully covered | Fully covered |
| HSA eligibility | Eligible | Not eligible |
| Employer HSA funding | $900 total, deposited as four $225 deposits in January, April, July, and October | None |

## Enrollment record

Sphere’s 2027 open-enrollment medical elections applied to the 2027 plan year. Elections could not be changed after October 23, 2026 at 5:00 PM Eastern without a qualifying life event.

This is a historical comparison of posted terms and the enrollment deadline; it does not constitute a recommendation or election.
